integrity: The coordinate reduction is exact. The packaged verifier checks determinant identities and the invertible linear coordinate transformation. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local classification for three cameras with linearly independent centers only. The uniqueness of the singular point is prior work; the new content is the explicit local identification with the \(3\times2\) rank-one determinantal/Segre cone and the resulting local invariants. An unindexed source could still contain the same local observation.
title: The three-camera line multiview singularity is a Segre cone
